title: crataegus columbiana var. brunetiana
intro: Crataegus columbiana var. brunetiana, commonly known as the hawthorn shrub, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. The health benefits associated with C. columbiana var. brunetiana include its potential to help with cardiovascular health, reduce blood pressure, and provide antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include acting as a vasodilator, improving heart function, and exerting anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include oligomeric proanthocyanidin (OPC) and other flavonoids, which contribute to its antioxidant and cardiovascular-protective effects.
